name: Final code checks
command:
set -e
(cd backend && npm run build && npm test)
(cd frontend && npm run test:reservation && npm run lint && npm run build)
python3 -m py_compile agents/app/*.py agents/agents/*.py agents/orchestration/*.py agents/schemas/*.py agents/tools/*.py agents/tests/*.py
git diff --check
printf 'final code checks: passed\n'
description: Re-run builds, unit tests, frontend checks, Python compilation, and diff validation after the final fixes.
